title: Lesson 6 Practice Schedule: 20-Minute Guitar Routine with Alternate Picking, G-C-D Chords, and 6/8 Strumming
summary: This video presents a concise 20-minute weekly practice schedule for JustinGuitar Lesson 6, focusing on finger flexibility, picking technique, chord accuracy, common chord changes, and rhythm in a 6/8 feel. The routine begins with a 1-minute finger stretch, includes a 1-minute single-string alternate-picking drill with attention to pick angle and in/out motion, then dedicates time to a G major chord perfect-practice exercise (arpeggiate the chord and finish with a strum). It adds 3 one-minute chord-change drills (G→C, G→D, C→D), followed by 2 minutes of strumming in 6/8 with a metronome. The session concludes with 10 minutes of song work, recommending 1–2 (ideally 2) songs that use G or fit 6/8 timing, and notes that a left-handed practice variant may extend the time. The instructor emphasizes tailoring the routine to the student’s weakest chords and personal pace, and offers practical notes on rhythm, timing, and left-hand practice.
topics: strum at end of chord exercise

sections.title: Finger Stretching Practice
sections.description: Sequence starts with a 1-minute finger stretch, followed by a 1-minute single-string alternate-picking focus (open strings, muted strings), emphasizing pick angle and the in/out motion. The left-handed perspective is acknowledged as more challenging.

sections.title: Alternate Picking Practice
sections.description: Sequence starts with a 1-minute finger stretch, followed by a 1-minute single-string alternate-picking focus (open strings, muted strings), emphasizing pick angle and the in/out motion. The left-handed perspective is acknowledged as more challenging.

sections.title: G Chord Perfect Practice
sections.description: Three 1-minute drills focused on essential chord transitions. Emphasizes that G→C and G→D are common changes; C→D is also a frequent pairing. Encourages practicing the hardest change for the individual and tailoring the routine accordingly.

sections.title: One Minute Changes
sections.description: Three 1-minute drills focused on essential chord transitions. Emphasizes that G→C and G→D are common changes; C→D is also a frequent pairing. Encourages practicing the hardest change for the individual and tailoring the routine accordingly.

sections.title: Strumming in 6:8
sections.description: Practice maintaining a 6/8 pulse with a metronome, focusing on the down-strum feel and the 1-2-3-4-5-6 accent. Attempts the 1,2&,3,4,5&,6 pattern to reinforce rhythmic accuracy and coordination with the right hand.

sections.title: Songs & Fun!
sections.description: Allocate about 10 minutes to song work. Choose at least one 6/8 song and one that uses a G chord; up to three songs for longer practice. Acknowledges the possibility of extending left-handed practice time (12–13 minutes) if desired, otherwise keep to the recommended 10 minutes.
